crossRefs.note: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing…
through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,
But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.
But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for…
But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in…
knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of…
The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one…
Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

parallels.note: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts

translations.web: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
translations.bsb: when they said to you, “In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow after their own ungodly desires.”
translations.kjv: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
translations.asv: That they said to you, In the last time there shall be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.
